title: 第七章 美狐狸第八章 祸水东引
slug: 凡人修仙苟在废丹房我偷偷成仙了
content_zh:
“咳......咳咳......”
大院内。
许天适时咳出一口黑痰，身子晃了晃，直接摔倒在地。
路过的李狗蛋嫌恶瞥了他一眼，下意识退后半步，捂住鼻子。
这种晦气瘟神，死了最好，别传染给自己。
李狗蛋转身，正准备去教训下一个不听话杂役。
就在这时。
紧闭的门，突然发出“吱呀”一声。
这声音很是刺耳。
所有人动作一顿，齐刷刷看向门口。
平日里，只有清晨倒药渣和傍晚送饭时，这扇门才会开。
现在是正午，门怎么会开？
孙管事那肥硕的身影率先走进来。
但今天他没有摆那副高高在上的架子，而是侧身，脸上挂着一种很是猥琐的笑。
“到了，就是这儿。”
搓搓手，孙管事眼睛眯成了一条缝。
在他的身后，一道倩影，缓缓跨过门槛。
一瞬间。
整个废丹大院里那股令人作呕的味道，都被一股幽香给冲散。
来者是一个女人。

一袭粉色薄纱长裙，布料少得可怜。
大片雪白肌肤裸露，泛着粉嫩光泽。
随着她跨门而入，裙摆摇曳。
腰肢如水蛇扭动，隐约可见那双修长美腿。
长相虽算不得多么出众，但在这群自打上山后连母猪都没见过的牲口眼里，这便是九天玄女下凡。
诱惑至极，更是要命至极。
“咕咚。”
人群中，不知是谁咽了一口唾沫。
紧随其后，是一片粗重呼吸声。
躁动。
弥漫整个院子。
原本麻木等死的眼神，渐渐被**占据。
这是......女人啊！
活生生的女人！
content_en:
"Cough...cough cough..."
In the courtyard.
Xu Tian coughed up a mouthful of black phlegm at the right time, staggered and fell to the ground.
Li Goudan, who was passing by, glanced at him in disgust, subconsciously stepped back and covered his nose.
It's best to die for this kind of bad luck and plague, don't infect yourself.
Li Goudan turned around and was about to teach the next disobedient handyman a lesson.
Just then.
The closed door suddenly made a "squeak" sound.
The sound was very harsh.
Everyone stopped and looked towards the door.
On weekdays, this door is only opened when medicine residue is poured out in the morning and meals are delivered in the evening.
It's noon, why is the door open?
The plump figure of Manager Sun walked in first.
But today, he didn't put on that high air, but turned sideways, with a very lewd smile on his face.
"Here we are, right here."
Rubbing his hands, Manager Sun narrowed his eyes.
Behind him, a beautiful figure slowly crossed the threshold.
For a moment.
The disgusting smell in the entire Feidan compound was washed away by a faint fragrance.
The visitor is a woman.
She was wearing a pink gauze dress with very little fabric.
A large area of ​​snow-white skin is exposed, glowing with a pink luster.
As she stepped through the door, her skirt swayed.
The waist twists like a water snake, and the slender legs are vaguely visible.
Although her appearance is not that outstanding, in the eyes of this group of animals who have never seen a sow since they went up the mountain, this is the mysterious goddess of the Nine Heavens descending to earth.
It's extremely tempting, and even more deadly.
"Gudong."
In the crowd, someone didn't know who swallowed.
Immediately afterwards, there was the sound of heavy breathing.
Restless.
Permeated the entire yard.
His eyes, which were originally numb and waiting for death, were gradually taken over by lust.
This is...a woman!
A living woman!
